verdict.rationale: Anytype's own docs say you can export your content at any time and choose Markdown, an open format, or its native Any-Block format. The self-host docs describe exporting all your channels, and data is stored locally on your device, with a documented local API (with a published OpenAPI spec) for programmatic access. missing for 10: confirmation that a whole-vault export is possible in Markdown rather than only Any-Block, details on how databases, relations and properties carry over in open formats, independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export-and-leave workflow.
